product_one_liner.value: Plannerly is a cloud-based BIM management platform that helps architecture, engineering, and construction professionals collaboratively plan, manage, and verify BIM projects.
product_one_liner.notes: The official product overview explicitly describes a cloud-based BIM management platform for AEC professionals to plan, manage, and verify BIM projects: https://help.plannerly.com/en/article/53-what-is-plannerly.

pricing_page.notes: Plannerly has a public pricing page: https://plannerly.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The official customer page includes product-use testimonials from Amazon’s Brad W and BNBuilders’ Chris Everist: https://plannerly.com/customers. | named_customers.0: An Amazon BIM manager gives a direct testimonial about managing projects with Plannerly: https://plannerly.com/customers. | named_customers.1: BNBuilders’ BIM manager gives a direct product-use testimonial: https://plannerly.com/customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly reports 11–20 employees: https://prospeo.io/c/plannerly-the-bim-management-platform. The narrower band comes from a third-party directory.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Plannerly’s company profile explicitly lists its headquarters as Irvine, CA: https://linkedin.com/company/plannerly. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters as Irvine, California, United States: https://prospeo.io/c/plannerly-the-bim-management-platform. This is a third-party source.

founded_year.notes: Plannerly’s company profile explicitly states that it was founded in 2017: https://linkedin.com/company/plannerly.

eng_blog.notes: The inspected blog index contains BIM standards, workflow, training, and product-use material rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Plannerly itself: https://plannerly.com/category/english.

public_docs.notes: The public help center includes an integrations collection explicitly containing five articles, satisfying the multiple-article requirement: https://help.plannerly.com/en/collection/11-integrations-external-connections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Unknown. No genuine Plannerly employer careers page or job board was found. The careers and jobs URLs displayed product pages rather than openings, so they do not justify a negative hiring answer: https://plannerly.com/careers/ and https://plannerly.com/jobs/.

model_provider.notes: Plannerly names OpenAI as the provider for optional AI features in its subprocessor list: https://plannerly.com/trust.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The DPA makes a public commitment to GDPR-compliant processing: https://plannerly.com/data/. This is a public compliance commitment, not an independently awarded certificate: https://plannerly.com/data/.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated changelog item is April 10, 2026, and the latest clearly substantial launch identified there is Live Dashboards in Docs on April 6—both before the six-month window: https://ideas.plannerly.com/changelog.
